_comment: The builder's call to the Rust envelope validator. Killed by the two tests that drive documents the TypeScript rule alone accepted — a backslash it splits on, and a NUL it never looks for.
verify: cd host && npx vitest run test/vfs-product-builder-contract.test.ts >/dev/null 2>&1

trials.name: the envelope is never validated in Rust
a refused document is treated as a valid one
the refusal reported is cargo's first warning, not the rule that fired
the miniature builder's permission is granted to every builder
